concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 4 - Data Quality and Scarcity Handling
concerns.text: US-4 defines three edge-case behaviors, but only the data-scarcity halt is backed by an FR (FR-004). The duplicate-yield-strength handling ('MUST average the values and record the standard deviation, or select the median, and log the selection method') and the descriptor domain-error handling ('MUST catch the exception, assign 0.0 or NaN, and log the alloy ID') have NO corresponding FR or SC. Add FRs (e.g., FR-007/FR-008) anchored to US-4, or these behaviors will be silently dropped at implementation.

US-4 has no success criteria at all — SC-001 through SC-004 all cite US-3 only. At minimum the deduplication and error-logging behaviors need a measurable outcome (e.g., every duplicate-composition alloy appears exactly once in the processed dataset with the aggregation method logged).

concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 1, Acceptance Scenario 3 vs FR-002
concerns.text: US-1 scenario 3 requires rejected entries be 'flagged in a rejected_entries.log file with the reason code', but FR-002 only says 'exclude entries with missing yield strength data' — the logging/traceability requirement is not carried into any FR. Extend FR-002 (or add an FR) to cover the rejection log.
